definition_text: Comparable restaurant sales represent the change in period-over-period total revenue for company-owned restaurants in operation for at least 13 full calendar months.
notes: Restaurants must be open at least 13 full calendar months. Company-owned restaurants only; the 10-K says so explicitly, while the Q1 2025 earnings release omitted the words company-owned. Fiscal year ends December 31, so there is no 53rd-week adjustment. Source: Item 7 MD&A, Overview, Sales Trends.

definition_text: Domestic same store sales reflects the change in year-over-year sales for the same store base. We define the same store base to include those restaurants open for at least 52 full weeks. This measure highlights the performance of existing restaurants, while excluding the impact of new restaurant openings and permanent closures. We review same store sales for domestic company-owned restaurants as well as system-wide domestic restaurants.
notes: Domestic restaurants only; international franchised restaurants are not in the base. Restaurants must be open at least 52 full weeks. The headline domestic same store sales growth covers franchised and company-owned restaurants together; company-owned domestic growth is reported separately and is not used in comps_quarterly. Fiscal 2025 had 52 weeks, so no 53rd-week adjustment applies; in its FY2022 10-K (a 53-week year) Wingstop calculated same store sales excluding the 53rd week. Source: Item 7 MD&A, Key Performance Indicators.

definition_text: Same-restaurant sales is a year-over-year comparison of each period’s sales volumes for a 52-week year, and is limited to restaurants that have been open and operated by Darden for at least 16 months, and excludes the impact of Chuy’s, as they were not owned and operated by Darden for a 16-month period prior to the beginning of fiscal 2026, as well as Bahama Breeze as all locations are expected to be closed or converted to other brands (between Q3 fiscal 2026 and Q4 fiscal 2027).
notes: Restaurants must be open and operated by Darden for at least 16 months. The 10-K text defines the annual metric as a 52-week comparison, and fiscal 2026 had 53 weeks; the Q4 FY2026 release says quarterly same-restaurant sales is a 13-week metric, while that quarter had 14 weeks. Chuy's was excluded until Q4 FY2026, and Bahama Breeze is excluded throughout. Quarterly values in comps_quarterly come from the earnings releases. Source: Item 7 MD&A, footnote 1 to the sales table.
